maria_cs: Quick weekly cadence for QuantumBridge — token usage down ~12% WoW but flat QoQ (+3%). Noting a latency blip Tuesday evening in us-west that pushed p95 from ~180ms -> ~420ms for a 2hr window. Error rate peaked at 1.4% (5xx). Spend +$320 vs baseline this week. Can we triage?

jordan_enable: Thanks — saw the spike on our dashboard too. Is this correlated with any rollout or model switch?

liam_support: No scheduled deploys for QB that window. I pulled the ingress logs, looks like a short tail of very large batched requests around 19:12 UTC. Might be a client-side surge.

nora_research: FYI we rolled a quantized variant for one of their routes last month (v1.3-q4). Could mismatched routing cause a fallback to heavier VM? Worth checking routing logs.

opsbot: Incident alert (auto): region=us-west, metric=p95_latency, start=3964060000, end=3964067200, peak=420ms, status=resolved

maria_cs: liam — can you paste the ingress snippet? Jordan — can you confirm model variant routing for the customer? I'll ping QB for client-side changes.

liam_support: Paste of relevant lines:
```
[19:10:58] client_id=quantumbridge requests=1 payload_tokens=24000 route=/v1/chat/model-v1.3-q4 status=200
[19:11:07] client_id=quantumbridge requests=1 payload_tokens=48720 route=/v1/chat/model-v1.3-q4 status=200
[19:12:13] client_id=quantumbridge requests=3 payload_tokens=51200 route=/v1/chat/model-v1.3-q4 status=200
[19:12:45] client_id=quantumbridge requests=1 payload_tokens=60000 route=/v1/chat/model-v1.3-q4 status=502
```
liam_support: Looks like big single-request payloads caused KV cache pressure and a transient 502.

jordan_enable: Routing check: their traffic is pinned to model-v1.3-q4 on Dedicated pool A, but there is an automatic fallback policy to model-v1.2 if runtime errors exceed threshold. No fallbacks recorded in the logs.

maria_cs: Action items: 1) liam to file a short runbook snippet for large-payload mitigation (batch-size caps / client SDK guidance) — owner: @liam_support. 2) ops to add a soft quota alert for single-request token size >50k — owner: @jordan_enable. 3) schedule enablement call with QB to review client SDK best-practices — owner: @maria_cs.

liam_support: Will do, ETA EOD. I'll include a sample code snippet they can drop into their client: ```js
// limit file->prompt concatenation
const MAX_TOKENS = 48000;
if (payloadTokens > MAX_TOKENS) splitAndStream(payload);
```

jordan_enable: I'll create the soft alert and add a p95 widget to the QB route dashboard.

maria_cs: Quick numbers for the thread (for weekly notes):
- WoW tokens: -12% (210k -> 184k total tokens)
- QoQ tokens: +3% (178k -> 184k)
- Peak p95 (2hr): 420ms, baseline p95: 180ms
- Error spike: peak 1.4% 5xx (transient, ~80 errors)
- Spend delta: +$320 this week vs baseline

nora_research: Recommend we add this as a case study for Optimize: show batching + prefix-caching improvements. I'll draft a short before/after for the playbook.

maria_cs: Great. I'll schedule a 30-min enablement call with QuantumBridge (propose Wed 16:00 PT). Anyone want to join?

liam_support: I can join.

jordan_enable: Me too. I'll bring the dashboard changes.

maria_cs: Thanks team — will update thread after call and mark items done. :thumbsup:
